name: mariadb-operator-test
description: Conduct in-depth, end-to-end testing of a mariadb-operator/mariadb-operator pull request in a local KIND environment, hunting for corner cases and failure modes to make the feature as robust and polished as possible before it is released. Builds a test plan from the PR, runs happy-path, reported-repro and failure-injection scenarios (process and container kills, retries, timeouts, concurrency, deletion mid-operation, operator restarts, manual interventions), fixes the gaps it finds, separates regressions from pre-existing and environmental failures, posts a test report on the PR through mariadb-operator-comment, and proposes which scenarios are worth promoting to CI integration tests. Use whenever the user wants a PR tested beyond its unit/integration tests — "test PR #1234 on KIND", "conduct additional testing for this PR", "harden this feature before we release it", "find corner cases in #1234", "make this PR robust".

findings.excerpt: | **Process kill** | `kubectl exec <pod> -c <container> -- sh -c 'kill -9 <pid>'` on the relevant process | Bash/shell handlers survive; the container exits non
